item.title: New burial plot for babies being created at Bohermore Cemetery
item.description: A new burial plot for babies is being added to Bohermore Cemetery as the existing section for this purpose is at full capacity. item.title: Over 2,600 Galway families received Newborn Baby Grant in 2025
item.description: More than 2,600 families in Galway recieved the Newborn Baby Grant in 2025 alongside their first month of child benefits. item.title: All-Ireland survey to help track squirrels and pine martens
item.description: The University of Galway is leading a new nationwide survey to understand the populations of red squirrels and pine martens, and if they have improved in recent years. The initiative is an invitation to members of the public to become Citizen Scientists and help track some of our most iconic woodland mammals. Led by researchers […]
